author: NingMeng123
revision: Final mod ore palette adaptation after user feedback
reference_preparation: Original 16x16 source images were enlarged to 1024x1024 with nearest-neighbor sampling only. Ordinary mod ore sprites are the mineral identity and palette authority. Vanilla raw_iron supplies only the raw item silhouette and stone matrix; vanilla deepslate supplies only host stone.
constraints: Final game sprites are 16x16 RGBA. Keep original ore minerals: neutral silver, near-white pale icy mithril, nearly black dark indigo adamantium. No ingot reference, no bright violet crystals. Block textures are opaque; raw items retain transparent padding.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: exact Minecraft pixel-art asset adaptation for an established mod. A 16x16 source has been uniformly enlarged to 1024x1024 for editing.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target: this mod's EXISTING ordinary silver ore. Its mineral pixels are the sole authority for mineral colors, size, positions and shapes. Image 2 is exact vanilla deepslate, to replace only the gray stone host.
Primary request: Create the DEEPSLATE variant of the ordinary ore in Image 1. Keep every mineral pixel in its existing location, color and shape. Replace only the surrounding medium-gray stone host with dark horizontally layered vanilla deepslate as in Image 2.
Color authority: MINERAL PIXELS ONLY: neutral grayscale silver white. Mineral highlights #FFFFFF, middle #E6E6E6, shadow #C3C3C3. No bluish tint. The gray stone host is not silver.
Grid constraints: retain exactly 16 by 16 logical pixels. 1024x1024 enlarged output means exactly 64x64 uniform squares for each logical source pixel. Do not add new micro-pixels or detail. A pixel must be a single flat color. Preserve recognizable existing ore flecks from the mod.
Composition: One flat opaque square tile, fills canvas edge to edge, same orientation as Image 1. Not a 3D cube.
Avoid: inventing a palette from the metal name, using an ingot palette, brightening dark adamantium, saturated blue mithril, crystals, gems, glow, redesigned flecks, additional clusters, new outlines, changing the stone lump shape, noise, gradients, antialiasing, blur, extra tiles, perspective, text, labels, checkerboard, scenery. Match the exact mod ore identity, with vanilla-style host stone.
